reuse.why: Introduces getFillableCategories and a hasSavedTemplates predicate that both the query-based actions and copyPreviousMonth use, and keeps setNMonthAvg/getBudgetData.

duplication.why: Removes the three copied category queries and merges the 6/12-month loops; the hidden rule is still expressed twice (SQL in getFillableCategories, JS in copyPreviousMonth) and set3MonthAvg keeps its own loop.

placement.why: Selection and predicate live in server/budget/actions.ts next to the month-wide actions that use them.

scope.why: Focused on the rule; the small set6/set12 consolidation and a release note are adjacent tidy-ups.

maintainability.why: The template rule has one named predicate and the selection one function, so future changes are mostly local; the hidden check in copyPreviousMonth remains a second place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; copyPreviousMonth uses the new hasSavedTemplates predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: The hidden/group_hidden checks in copyPreviousMonth openly mirror the SQL filter of getFillableCategories.

one_place.where: The template exclusion is one predicate (hasSavedTemplates) used by every path, but the hidden/hidden-group exclusion is decided both in getFillableCategories' SQL and in copyPreviousMonth's own JS checks.
